Card Q&A.q: Can this card's inherited effect delete an opponent's [Sukamon] to prevent itself from being deleted?

Card Q&A.a: No, it can't interrupt it. Until the processing for the 1st interruption has resolved, only 1 activation is possible for each "when [...] would" effect. In your case, until the deletion of the 1st only [Sukamon] A is resolved, only 1 interruption is possible for each "when [...] would" effect, so because [Sukamon] A's effect has already interrupted, it can't interrupt again.
Card Q&A.q: I have [Sukamon] A and [Sukamon] B with this card in their digivolution cards in the battle area. When [Sukamon] A would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] B using this card's inherited effect. On the other hand, when [Sukamon] B would be deleted, I attempted to delete [Sukamon] A using this card's inherited effect. At such times, can [Sukamon] A interrupt this card's inherited effect again?

Card Q&A.a: This effect changes 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a Digimon whose original name is [Sukamon], its original color is white, and its original DP is 3000.
Card Q&A.q: What does a "change 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]" effect do, exactly?

Card Q&A.a:
The card information gained from the (Rule) will also be changed. For example, BT15-035 [Geremon]'s (Rule) gives it an original name of [Geremon/Numemon], but if its original card information is changed by this effect, its original name becomes just [Sukamon].

Card Q&A.q: If a card such as BT15-035 [Geremon] has a (Rule) that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?

Card Q&A.a:
The card information gained from the effect remains as-is. For example, if EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s original card information is changed, its original color will become white, and EX1-005 [Tyrannomon]'s effect will also treat it as green, making it a 2-color white and green Digimon.

Card Q&A.q: If a card such as EX1-005 [Tyrannomon] has an effect that gives it card information, what happens when this card's effect changes it to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP?

Card Q&A.a: It remains as a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon]. The gained effect is carried over even if the Digimon digivolves or one or more of its top cards are trashed.
Card Q&A.q: If a card is changed to a white Digimon with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then it digivolves or its top card is trashed by  or other effect, what happens to that card's information?

Card Q&A.a: It remains changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, but any card information that it didn't originally have can't be changed. If it becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card, or if it becomes a card that didn't originally have DP, then it will remain without DP.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if a card is changed to a white card with an original name of [Sukamon] and 3000 DP, then its top card is trashed by  or other effect and the top card becomes a Tamer or Digi-Egg card?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] If your opponent has 16 or more cards in their trash, or you have 3 or more cards with [Sukamon] in their names in your trash, change 1 of your opponent's Digimon into a white Digimon with 3000 DP and an original name of [Sukamon] until the end of your opponent's turn.
[When Attacking] For each other Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name in play, this Digimon gains ＜Security Attack +1＞ for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, by deleting 1 other Digimon with [Sukamon] in its name, prevent that deletion.
